reconstruction.roof: Broad central pale-green region with shallow transverse crown, with separate peripheral service regions; partition derived using source polygon clipping, not measured roof cadastral parts. Former unused generic central 12 x 7 m box removed from the geometry helper.
reconstruction.facades: Two west elevations use photo-fitted high window groups, brown rendered base, actual cut openings, inset solid door / service louvres, returns, separate dark metal frames, outward-tilted pale awning panes, downpipes / clips and small vents. reconstruction.limits: Exact crown profile, roof regions, opening intervals, two fan-unit count / dimensions, face assignment, materials, fine levels, rear openings and current access are estimates or unverified. The 8 m map height is retained conflicting evidence, not asserted as surveyed reality. Photo / Google pixels are not copied into the scene.
